## Consumer requirement

Describe the concrete user workflow or bug this change addresses.

## Observable change

List affected commands, inputs, outputs, exit codes, documentation, or packaging.
State `none` for runtime/API changes when appropriate.

## Verification

- [ ] Added or updated synthetic tests.
- [ ] Ran the full test suite.
- [ ] Ran `git diff --check`.
- [ ] Checked documentation links and machine-readable examples.
- [ ] Confirmed no credentials, private paths/data, or restricted assets are included.
- [ ] Confirmed claims remain mechanical and do not imply scientific validity or publication judgment.

## Compatibility and release notes

Document backward-compatibility impact, dependency changes, and whether the
changelog or release-readiness register needs an update.
